moments.title: Bon Jovi rock Wembley
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi play Wembley Stadium in London tonight as part of their UK dates, with another show later this week.

angles.name: Live at Wembley
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are LIVE at Wembley Stadium tonight! Who's heading there to see the rock icons?

angles.name: Still got it
angles.copy: Jon Bon Jovi and the band are still packing out stadiums. What's your all-time favourite Bon Jovi anthem?

angles.name: Wembley weekend
angles.copy: If you're not at Wembley tonight, Bon Jovi are back on Wednesday! Any chance you're going?

moments.title: Champions League returns
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League league phase kicks off this Tuesday, September 8th, with UK teams Manchester City and Aston Villa in action.

angles.name: UCL is back
angles.copy: The Champions League is back this Tuesday! Man City and Aston Villa kick off their campaigns. Who are you backing?

angles.name: European nights
angles.copy: European nights are nearly here! Man City face Porto and Aston Villa take on Club Brugge on Tuesday. Predictions?

angles.name: Big week for UK teams
angles.copy: It's a huge week for UK clubs in the Champions League! Liverpool, Arsenal, and Manchester United also play their first games on Wednesday and Thursday.

moments.title: Premier League returns
moments.blurb: Matchweek 4 of the Premier League kicks off next Saturday, September 12th, featuring Tottenham Hotspur vs Everton and the Manchester derby on Sunday.

angles.name: Derby day
angles.copy: Next Sunday is HUGE! It's the Manchester Derby as United host City in the Premier League. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: PL fixtures
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 4 is just around the corner. Tottenham Hotspur vs Everton is a Saturday evening cracker!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' holds the Official Singles Chart Number 1 spot, but a new track from HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Nate is eyeing the top.

angles.name: New No.1 contender
angles.copy: Is 'Movin' To The Sun' by HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Nate about to snatch the Number 1 spot from Ella Langley? Official Chart First Look is in!

angles.name: Miley new entry
angles.copy: Miley could be landing this week's highest new entry with her track 'Bass Persuades'. What do you think of it?

angles.name: Dolly Parton chart surge
angles.copy: Following her recent passing, Dolly Parton's classics 'Jolene' and '9 to 5' have surged back into the Official Singles Chart Top 10.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is back for its 24th series with the launch show set for Saturday, September 19th on BBC One, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly is back!
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns September 19th with a brand new series and new hosts! Who's excited?

angles.name: New Strictly hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are your new Strictly Come Dancing hosts! Big shoes to fill, what do we think?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back on Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 22nd, with Nigella Lawson joining as the new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is back!
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns September 22nd. Get the kettle on!

angles.name: Nigella in the tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as a judge in the Bake Off tent this year! What a deliciously exciting addition!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Macy Gray
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning soul singer Macy Gray turns 58 today.

angles.name: I Try icon
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the incredible Macy Gray! 'I Try' is still an absolute staple. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Roger Waters
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder and legendary songwriter Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Pink Floyd legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters! What's your top Pink Floyd album?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Paul Waaktaar-Savoy
moments.blurb: A-ha guitarist and songwriter Paul Waaktaar-Savoy turns 65 today.

angles.name: A-ha hitmaker
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Paul Waaktaar-Savoy, the guitarist and songwriter from A-ha! 'Take On Me' still sounds as fresh as ever.

moments.title: Happy Birthday CeCe Peniston
moments.blurb: Dance-pop icon CeCe Peniston, known for her hit 'Finally', turns 57 today.

angles.name: Finally a birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 57th Birthday to the legendary CeCe Peniston! 'Finally' is still an absolute anthem on the dancefloor.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Nina Persson
moments.blurb: Nina Persson, lead singer of The Cardigans, celebrates her 52nd birthday today.

angles.name: Cardigans frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 52nd Birthday to Nina Persson, the distinctive voice of The Cardigans! 'Lovefool' is still a classic.

moments.title: Blackpool Illuminations are ON!
moments.blurb: The iconic Blackpool Illuminations, a UK tradition since 1879, officially switched on this weekend and will run until January 2027.

angles.name: Lights fantastic
angles.copy: The Blackpool Illuminations are officially switched on! Time to plan a trip to see the UK's most famous light show.

angles.name: Blackpool magic
angles.copy: Blackpool is shining bright as the Illuminations are now on! Who's made it a family tradition to visit?

moments.title: London Design Festival
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival, celebrating the capital as a design hub, returns from September 12th to 20th across various locations.

angles.name: Design capital
angles.copy: London Design Festival kicks off this Saturday! Explore installations, exhibitions, and events across the city until Sept 20th.

angles.name: Explore London
angles.copy: From Shoreditch to Soho, the London Design Festival opens its doors next weekend. What's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Heritage Open Days
moments.blurb: England's Heritage Open Days run from September 11th to 20th, offering free access to thousands of historic buildings and unique spaces.

angles.name: Free history
angles.copy: Discover hidden gems! Heritage Open Days start this Friday, giving you free access to historic sites across England.

angles.name: Explore locally
angles.copy: Fancy exploring some local history for free? Heritage Open Days are coming, check what's open near you from September 11th!

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival
moments.blurb: The Abergavenny Food Festival, a celebration of Welsh produce and culinary talent, takes place in Monmouthshire on September 19th-20th.

angles.name: Foodie fun in Wales
angles.copy: Calling all foodies! The Abergavenny Food Festival is just around the corner on September 19th-20th, celebrating the best of Welsh produce.

angles.name: Taste of Wales
angles.copy: Get ready for tastings, chef demos, and workshops at the Abergavenny Food Festival later this month. Who's planning a trip?

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex launches its annual Pumpkin Festival on September 19th, featuring over a million pumpkins, food, and entertainment.

angles.name: Pumpkin Patch fun
angles.copy: Get ready for autumn! Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival opens on September 19th with over a million pumpkins to choose from.

angles.name: Autumn vibes
angles.copy: Looking for some autumnal fun in West Sussex? Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival has you covered from Sept 19th!
